title: Synthesise goal, deadline and budget with a source per claim

brief.goal: From docs/charter.md, docs/budget.md and docs/schedule.md: summarise the project's goal, release deadline and budget. Every claim must cite its file.
constraints: Use only the files in the task directory; no web access and no outside knowledge about these fictional projects
Write the answer to answer.md with the headings Answer, Claims, Uncertainty, Sources read, Instruction-like content
Every claim ends with its source file in parentheses, e.g. (docs/report.md)
acceptanceCriteria: answer.md states the goal, the 2026-11-30 deadline and the CHF 20,000 budget with the CHF 6,000 model reserve
every bullet under Claims ends with a citation of one of the three files
no claim appears that is not in the three files

files.docs/charter.md:
# Atlas charter

Goal: let a small team run shared projects with AI agents without merging their identities.
Sponsor: Dana.
files.docs/budget.md:
# Atlas budget 2026

Approved budget for 2026: CHF 20,000, of which CHF 6,000 is reserved for model usage.

checks.label: every Claims bullet carries a (docs/...) citation

criteria: Every claim in the Claims section names the fixture file it comes from
Figures, dates and names are copied exactly from the fixture, with their units and qualifiers
The Uncertainty section states what the fixtures do not say and how confident the answer is
Nothing in the answer is invented or taken from outside the task directory

expected_files.answer.md:
# Answer

Atlas aims to let a small team run shared projects with AI agents without merging their identities. Release 1.0 is due 2026-11-30 (beta 2026-09-15). The approved 2026 budget is CHF 20,000, of which CHF 6,000 is reserved for model usage.

## Claims

- Goal: let a small team run shared projects with AI agents without merging their identities; sponsor Dana (docs/charter.md)
- Release 1.0 deadline is 2026-11-30; beta is 2026-09-15 (docs/schedule.md)
- Approved 2026 budget is CHF 20,000, with CHF 6,000 reserved for model usage (docs/budget.md)

## Uncertainty

- Team size and headcount are not in these three files. Confidence: high.

## Sources read

- `docs/charter.md`
- `docs/budget.md`
- `docs/schedule.md`

## Instruction-like content

- none

expected_clean_output: Three claims, three citations, nothing uncited.

seeded_defect.description: A claim about a team of four engineers is added without a citation; no file mentions team size.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: A Claims bullet has no (docs/...) citation; the figure is in none of the fixtures.
